title: Oreganeaux's Enhanced Vanilla
description: Oreganeaux's idea of the ideal vanilla Minecraft experience
body:
Enhances the vanilla experience with over 100 mods! This pack contains both cosmetic mods to make the game more interesting, and QOL mods to make your life easier!

Some examples of these mods include:

- **Ambient Sounds** to bring a bit more life to the soundscape of minecraft
- **AppleSkin** for information about food and saturation
- **Auto Plant Crops** to cut down on time wasted replanting crops while farming
- **Better Third Person** so you can get a full 360 on your character
- **Continuity** to bring more functionality to resource packs
- **Controlify** for those who prefer playing with a controller
- **Controlling** to make changing keybinds easier
- **Dark Loading screen** so you arent blinded by the loading screen
- **Distant horizons** to extend the view range
- **Emoji type** to make typing emojis in chat easier
- **Essential Mod** to make playing with friends easier
- **Falling Leaves** to add some visual ambiance to trees
- **Immersive UI** to make time spent in your inventory more interesting
- **Iris Shaders** for shader use in fabric
- **More Chat History** so you can always see what your friends have said
- **Not Enough Animations** to make players seem more lifelike
- **Nvidium** to make minecraft run better with Nvidia graphics cards **(Remove this mod if you do not use an Nvidia graphics card)**
- **RyoamicLights** for dynamic lighting and entity light emission
- **Shulker Box Tooltip** so you can always see whats in your boxes
- **Sound Physics Remastered** for echoey caves
- **VTDownloader** so you can select Vanilla Tweaks resource packs without even leaving your game
- **Visuality** to bring more interesting particle effects to the game
- **Wavey Capes** to add wavey physics to capes
- **Xaero's Minimap and World Map** so you can always see where you are
- **Zoomify** so you can zoom in like with optifine
- **And many more!**

Always check which mods are not allowed on servers before joining with any modpacks!! You've been warned!
